description: This file defines the MenuSessionsInjector class responsible for managing dynamic menu content related to sessions, nodes, and usage statistics in a macOS application. It handles injecting menu items, submenus, and previews, as well as cache management and observing control channel states.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjector
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the injection of dynamic menu items related to sessions, nodes, and usage data into an NSMenu in a macOS application. Handles cache updates, control channel observation, and user interactions within the menu.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Initializes the injector by attaching it to an NSStatusItem and sets up delegate and cache refresh.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Prepares and injects menu items when the menu is about to be shown, updating cache and node data.

methods.name: startControlChannelObservation
methods.description: Begins observing the control channel state to refresh menu data dynamically.

methods.name: observeControlChannelState
methods.description: Tracks changes in the control channel state and triggers cache refresh and menu update.

methods.name: handleControlChannelStateChange
methods.description: Handles updates when the control channel state changes, refreshing data and injecting menu items.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Fetches the latest session snapshot, respecting refresh intervals and control channel connection status.

methods.name: refreshUsageCache
methods.description: Fetches the latest usage summary data, with cache controls.

methods.name: refreshCostUsageCache
methods.description: Fetches the latest cost usage data analysis, with cache controls.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Main method to inject session-related menu items into a specified NSMenu, including headers, session rows, and usage sections.

methods.name: injectNodes
methods.description: Injects node information and device entries into the menu.

methods.name: buildSubmenu
methods.description: Creates a detailed submenu for a session row, including recent messages, controls, and logs.

methods.name: makeHostedView
methods.description: Creates an NSView hosting a SwiftUI view with specified width and highlight style.

methods.name: captureMenuWidthIfAvailable
methods.description: Records the menu's width if available, used for layout consistency.
